During the Congress, MBRSC announced the opening of applications for PHI-3, the third opportunity under the Payload Hosting Initiative, developed in partnership with the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA) through its ‘Access to Space for All’ initiative. The Centre also extended its cooperation with France’s space agency, CNES, in support of future missions under the Emirates Lunar Mission.
